model_contract.acceptance: The finite premise and failed conclusion are recomputed from the serialized adjacency certificate by a same-executor replay. This is a consistency check, not independent verification.
model_contract.conclusion: #F_ef * #F <= #F_e * #F_f for the uniform family F of all forests of G
model_contract.counterexample: G is a finite simple graph and e,f are distinct edges of G and NOT (#F_ef * #F <= #F_e * #F_f for the uniform family F of all forests of G)
model_contract.limitations: No candidate in a finite corpus is not a proof of the unbounded claim.
model_contract.objects: finite simple graphs, with any auxiliary finite data stated below
model_contract.premise: G is a finite simple graph and e,f are distinct edges of G
model_contract.source_statement: Let G be a finite graph, let e,f in E(G), and let F be the edge set of a forest chosen uniformly at random from all forests of G. Then P(e in F | f in F) <= P(e in F).
